verdict.rationale: Snowflake supports Apache Iceberg tables backed by customer-managed external cloud storage in an open table format, explicitly positioned for data lakes you 'cannot or choose not to store in Snowflake,' and the headless Snowflake CLI/SQL surface lets an agent script bulk queries/extracts. However, there's no documented bulk 'export everything' tooling (e.g., COPY INTO unload workflows to Parquet/CSV en masse) or migration-out guide in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit bulk data-export/unload documentation, a stated data-portability or account-migration-out guide, and independent confirmation that full account data can be moved out losslessly.
